'''D. Suffy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang. During the [[Dantooine Incursion]] D. Suffy had hidden most of the loot he plundered from the raid since he did not trust any of the other lieutenants such as [[Yarvok]]. D. Suffy then split up the directions to the treasure parts to ensure the others could not find it.<ref>{{TORcite|Dantooine Incursion}}</ref>
